natural_body: Price-sensitive SMB 40% off: signups +31%, rev +18%, retention -12%.

first.rationale: Onboarding completion and activation are both declining, and prior evidence indicates that shortening onboarding and simplifying signup improved completion, time-to-value, adoption, and durable first-week activation. This is better aligned with sustainable qualified revenue than matching competitor pricing, which previously reduced retention despite near-term signup and revenue gains. Verify the two most directly relevant onboarding records before committing.
